failure_reason: Task 009 is only partially implemented. The dashboard and compose submission reauthorize after access loss, but other access-sensitive already-open LiveViews retain private content after membership or conversation-access revocation. MemberMessageLive.Show does not handle GroupMembership, Membership, or ConversationGroupAccess notifications, and MemberMessageDeliveryLive.Show does not subscribe to read-model changes at all. The already-open compose screen also retains its private group metadata after access loss, despite rejecting submission. This conflicts with the plan requirement to reflect permission changes in an already-open LiveView.
